The '''Ghrag Mercenaries Base''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] hidden in the [[Tyyyn Nebula]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]]. It was used by the [[Ghrag Mercenaries]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Ghrag starfighters attacked anyone who dared to fly too close to the station.<ref name="SWG:RotW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ghrag Mercenaries Base was a location in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the second expansion for [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. It could be found in the Kashyyyk system.

The base looked like the wreck of a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]].
